note: Manual classification of the counterexamples the guided search found in the 12 natural briefs (summary.json m4 and certs/), made by reading the failing points, the event intervals and the scripts after the run. 'design' means the script really misbehaves inside its own declared range; 'brief' means the pre-registered brief (78d3b57) asserted something that is not true of a correct part, so the counterexample is an error in the brief, not in the design. Formulas marked analytic were checked against the measured value; mechanisms marked unverified were not.

flange.found: breakout (faces, edges, size-x, size-y) and min_wall
flange.measured: event guard: counts change between Diameter 51.875 and 53.75 (analytic breakout 53.2); min_wall verdict changes between 56.5625 (margin -0.008 mm) and 56.914 (+0.080 mm), analytic 56.56 for the 0.84 mm fail line

box-with-lid.found: Clearance below 0 clashes (status warning, no-clash, lip-gap); Clearance 0 lists no gap line (mated contact exempt), so lip-gap fails
box-with-lid.measured: bisection between Clearance 0.0156 (pass) and -0.0625 (fail); the special value Clearance 0 fails lip-gap alone
box-with-lid.not_found: with the watch distance raised to 2 mm by the spike, Clearance 0.6 to 1 lists its gap and passes; the 0.5 mm watch-distance blind spot does not appear under the spike's settings

bracket.found: builds fails (KERNEL_FILLET_FAILED) at Thickness 2, the bottom of the declared range 2..10, for every Screw, Width and Leg tried (20 points)
bracket.boundary: event between Thickness 2 (error) and 2.125 (builds), Width 40, Leg 35, M3; 2.11 with M4 also builds

bracket.found: the base holes cut into the upright, and the wall holes into the base, at short Leg with thick Thickness and M5
bracket.analytic: hole centre at 0.62 x Leg = 12.4, M5 radius 2.75, so the hole reaches y 9.65 < Thickness 10

bracket.found: min_wall 0.751 mm between the holes and the side edges at narrow Width with thick Thickness and M5
bracket.analytic: hole centre at W/4 + T/4 = 8.5, edge at 11.25, side at 12: 0.75 mm

knob.found: size-z fails for Height 12 and below: the 12 mm deep D-bore (z -1 to 12) opens the dome top
knob.measured: event between Height 12 (fails, faces 27) and 12.25 (passes, faces 28); size_z 9.915 at Height 10
knob.masked: just above 12 the skin over the bore is thin (Height - 12 mm), but min_wall already fails at nominal (a nominal failure), so the envelope cannot report it

tapered-cup.found: min_wall fails for Wall below about 1.42 mm (declared range 1.2..5)
tapered-cup.measured: bisection: Wall 1.4234 at Height 65.86 passes, Wall 1.3625 at Height 65.63 fails (0.793 mm); 0.531 mm at Height 120, Wall 1.2 (face 7)
tapered-cup.mechanism: unverified; the thinnest wall is well under the declared Wall, so it is not the side wall itself (perhaps the 3 mm base fillet against the cavity corner)

vented-box.found: the top vent row (z 28.5 to 31.5) thins and then cuts the rim for Height below about 32.3 (declared 25..80)
vented-box.measured: Height 32.27 min_wall 0.766 mm, Height 31.56 0.062 mm; Height 25 changes faces 167 to 118 or 130

vented-box.found: the outer vent columns (x 15 to 33) run into the rounded corners for Width below about 78, and into the end walls below about 70 (declared 60..160)
vented-box.measured: edges 540 or 588 instead of 492 at Width 60 to 76.6; min_wall 0.021 mm at Width 66.4, 0.072 mm at Width 70.3
vented-box.analytic: the straight part of the long walls ends at W/2 - 6 and the inner end wall is at W/2 - 2

gear-blank.found: size-x fails for every odd tooth count (9 to 59) and for 57 to 60 teeth
gear-blank.why: the brief pre-registered size_x = 54 for every Teeth value; an odd-toothed gear has a gap, not a tooth tip, on the -x side (52.88 at 9 teeth), and from 57 teeth a neighbouring tooth corner reaches past x = 27 (54.008 to 54.048). The whole box (53 integer values) was enumerated, so the gear blank was checked at every allowed value; its brief, not its geometry, is wrong.

lid-interference.found: status and clash fail for Clearance 0 and above
lid-interference.why: a negative test that must clash; its declared range (-1..1, copied from box-with-lid) includes non-clashing values. Bisection boundary between Clearance -0.056 and 0.025.

enclosure.found: no counterexample, but shank-in-pocket fails at nominal
enclosure.why: the spike raises the fit watch distance to 2 x the largest gap bound (1 mm here); that exposes a further 0.7 mm gap between base and screw, and the bench distance check bounds every gap of a counted pair, so an assertion that holds at the default 0.5 mm watch distance fails. A problem of the spike's watch-distance rule, not of the design.

held.enclosure: holds at 64 points apart from 2 nominal failures (shank-in-pocket above, gate-overhang-base predicted in the brief)
held.hinge: holds at 64 points apart from 1 nominal failure (gate-overhang-leaf)
held.phone-stand: holds at 64 points apart from 1 nominal failure (gate-overhang)
held.pegboard-hook: holds at 64 points apart from 1 nominal failure (gate-overhang)

count: 4 of 12 natural scripts have design defects beyond the 2 known cases (bracket 3 modes, knob 1, tapered-cup 1, vented-box 2); 3 briefs were wrong (gear-blank, lid-interference, enclosure nominal); 4 hold apart from nominal failures.
